name: Natural
description: Your unprocessed voice.

name: Deep
description: A lower voice, shifted down five semitones.

name: Chipmunk
description: A bright, high voice, shifted up seven semitones.

name: Helium
description: A squeaky voice a full octave higher.

name: Giant
description: A huge, slow-sounding voice a full octave lower.

name: Monster
description: A deep, rough voice with low pitch and distortion.

name: Demon
description: A growling, layered voice with dark modulation.

name: Villain
description: A smooth, menacing voice with a touch of room.

name: Robot
description: A mechanical voice with slow metallic modulation.

name: Alien
description: A strange, metallic voice with fast ring modulation.

name: Cyborg
description: Half human, half machine, slightly lowered.

name: Ghost
description: A trembling, airy voice drifting in a long hall.

name: Radio
description: A narrow, gritty broadcast voice.

name: Telephone
description: A thin, old telephone voice.

name: Megaphone
description: A crunchy loudspeaker voice with a short slapback.

name: 8-bit
description: A crunchy, low-resolution retro game voice.

name: Underwater
description: A muffled, wobbling voice from below the surface.

name: Echo
description: Short repeating echoes behind your voice.

name: Cathedral
description: A spacious voice with a long room reverb.

name: Cave
description: Dark echoes bouncing off damp stone walls.

name: Stadium
description: A huge announcer voice with long, wide echoes.

name: Chorus
description: A wider, doubled voice with gently moving copies.

name: Harmony
description: Your voice with two higher harmony voices behind it.

name: Wobble
description: A wavering voice with a fast pitch vibrato.

name: Flutter
description: A rapidly pulsing, stuttering volume effect.
